verdict.rationale: Adyen docs claim a 'standalone terminal solution' for quick setup and Customer Area management of terminals, but the core integration model is API/JSON-based (Terminal API) requiring developer work, not a simple merchant self-serve pairing flow. A firsthand community account describes needing to integrate with Adyen's terminal architecture taking 'hundreds of hours,' directly contradicting the 'minutes' expectation for a merchant-ops user.
